item.title: Rallying Cry – August 25, 2026
item.description: A federal judge struck down Trump’s visa ban on 75 countries, a Christian convert deported from the U.S. found a new home in Europe, Singapore and Vietnam are teaming up on tech, and a WNBA star just shattered a historic rebound record.
